name: @theoria/docs-model
description: Shared generated documentation contracts for Theoria

scripts.lint: cd ../.. && oxlint packages/docs-model && eslint --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/eslint/ --max-warnings=0 packages/docs-model && dprint check "packages/docs-model/**"
scripts.lint:fix: cd ../.. && oxlint --fix packages/docs-model && eslint --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/eslint/ --max-warnings=0 --fix packages/docs-model && dprint fmt "packages/docs-model/**"
